observed: Two boxes returned normally; the third box was mined but left on the ground when the controller ended. The user recovered it.
root_cause: Dropped ItemEntity telemetry exposed an empty contains list. The controller incorrectly required full box contents before initiating pickup.
fix: Remember item UUIDs present before mining the owned box
Identify only one new matching box drop near the verified removal, rejecting ambiguous or pre-existing drops
Validate full remaining contents after the box is in inventory
Register temporary-resource cleanup and run it before stopping the safety heartbeat
Keep uncertain stages recorded and never count a failed return as completion
safety: Manual takeover and low-health safety interlocks still override cleanup actions. An unresolved cleanup is reported explicitly; it is not a completed workflow.
verification: Regression tests cover hidden drop contents, unrelated and ambiguous boxes, inventory content checks, original-slot return and cleanup ordering. New fix has not yet been live-retested.
